target: 100% completion on the standalone 1994 Mega Drive / Genesis cartridge

areas.name: Before Starting
areas.location_cue: the Sonic 3 title screen leading to three save panels
areas.note: Set up the three character files before entering the first zone.

levels.1: Confirm the soundtrack before committing a save.
levels.2: Use the standalone 1994 Mega Drive or Genesis cartridge image, not the modern compilation.
levels.3: Boot the cartridge to its Sonic 3 title and three-slot Data Select screen. Keep this standalone game separate from the lock-on campaign; its original recordings and stage logic are the intended archive route.

levels.1: The data screen has exactly enough room for the main character choices.
levels.2: Create one file each for Sonic & Tails, Sonic alone, and Tails alone.
levels.3: At Data Select, assign the three save slots to Sonic & Tails, Sonic, and Tails. Keep their emerald progress separate. Use No Save only for codes or disposable experiments, never for completion evidence.

levels.1: One selection combines speed with assisted vertical reach.
levels.2: Choose the paired portrait on one dedicated save slot.
levels.3: Complete the cartridge with Sonic leading and Tails accompanying him. A second controller may make Tails fly, carry Sonic, activate switches, or attack independently; allow him to respawn if he leaves the screen.

levels.1: The grounded solo route exposes which shortcuts truly need assistance.
levels.2: Choose Sonic without the companion portrait on a separate file.
levels.3: Finish every act as Sonic alone. Use the midair second press for his brief extended attack, and record any hidden gateways that require momentum or shield movement instead of flight.

levels.1: Aerial movement reveals a distinct set of vertical routes.
levels.2: Choose Tails alone on the remaining save slot.
levels.3: Complete all acts as Tails alone. Tap the jump button again to fly, refresh before his tails tire, and use swimming underwater. He may collect the full emerald set, but this cartridge gives him no transformation.

levels.1: Sonic has a brief aerial technique that safely extends an attack.
levels.2: While airborne without an elemental shield, press a jump button again.
levels.3: Jump as Sonic, then tap A, B, or C just before contact. The flash briefly enlarges his attack boundary; use it to hit small openings while keeping his body clear of spikes, arms, or drill tips.

levels.1: One shield turns fire hazards into safe approach windows.
levels.2: Break the red elemental monitor and test a second jump in open air.
levels.3: The Flame Shield blocks fire and converts Sonic's airborne second press into a horizontal burst. Water removes it immediately, so spend its mobility before entering a pool.

levels.1: The blue shield changes both breathing and downward movement.
levels.2: Break its monitor, enter water, then press jump again on land.
levels.3: The Water Shield removes the drowning timer. On land, Sonic's second jump input drives him straight down and rebounds from the floor; use repeated bounces to attack or reach vertical openings.

levels.1: A magnetic shield improves both collection and jump height.
levels.2: Break the yellow elemental monitor and jump twice near loose rings.
levels.3: The Lightning Shield pulls nearby rings toward the character. Sonic gains a true double jump while wearing it, but touching water removes the shield, so collect high passages first.

areas.name: Angel Island Zone
areas.location_cue: the tropical shoreline and palm-covered jungle
areas.note: Use a cleared save later if one hidden gateway was passed.

levels.1: Carry protection into the first mechanical gate.
levels.2: Take the Flame Shield from the ledge immediately before the gate.
levels.3: Enter with the Flame Shield, stay above the flamethrower, and strike the machine's upper body whenever it settles. Six clean hits open the route; never attack from underneath.

levels.1: Explore below the early swinging-rope route.
levels.2: Near the beginning, drop to the lower path and check left of the large rock.
levels.3: After the first hill, let the weak floor drop you beside the swinging ropes. Face left and spin-dash through the grey boulder; the concealed room immediately behind it holds the Giant Ring.

levels.1: A later cave hides a route beneath its obvious floor.
levels.2: After the environment changes, enter the cave, break through the lower floor, and work left.
levels.3: Continue past the cave's first barriers, then drop through the breakable floor to the lowest passage. Spin through the rocks on the left and use the vertical spring, steering aside so you land beside the ring instead of overshooting its chamber.

levels.1: The final platform has unsafe open edges.
levels.2: Leave the wooden bridge as soon as the encounter starts and fight from the solid centre.
levels.3: Move off the bridge before it collapses. Read which side of the waterfall opens, dodge the two cannon shots, then jump into the craft as its volley ends. Repeat for eight hits and never chase it over either edge.

levels.1: The first fast tunnel passes a breakable room entrance.
levels.2: Roll through the winding tunnel, break the boulder at its exit, then turn back left.
levels.3: Stay curled through the opening tunnel so momentum breaks the boulder on the right. Stop immediately, reverse direction, and enter the room you just exposed; the Giant Ring is waiting to the left.

levels.1: Search the bottom of the broad waterfall climb.
levels.2: At the wide waterfall with protruding blocks, enter the small pool at bottom right.
levels.3: Before climbing the waterfall, sink into its lower-right pool. Charge a spin-dash facing right and release into the curved wall; hold right through the rise to break into the hidden Giant Ring room.

levels.1: A second movement set opens passages the faster route can miss.
levels.2: Revisit both acts as Tails alone, then with Sonic and a controller-two helper.
levels.3: Use Tails' flight, swimming, and carrying in every vertical split; then repeat as Sonic alone for grounded-only paths. A cleared save permits act selection, so no new story run is required.

areas.name: Hydrocity Zone
areas.location_cue: the submerged stone channels with rushing blue water
areas.note: Surface routes and underwater routes reconnect at different heights.

levels.1: The round chamber rewards patience between fast passes.
levels.2: Jump over the rolling mechanism, then attack when it rests on the centre column.
levels.3: Stay out of the water where possible. Clear each wall-to-wall sweep with one jump, then strike only after the four orbiting missiles stop at the centre column. Six hits finish the mechanism before drowning becomes a concern.

levels.1: A fragile upper path conceals a left-side landing.
levels.2: Take the high alternate route through the loop and stand on the left edge of the thin road.
levels.3: After the fan-and-belt route launches you through a loop, slow down on the narrow collapsing floor. Let its left edge give way and hold left throughout the fall to enter the Giant Ring alcove.

levels.1: Near the exit, inspect the last left-facing alcove before climbing.
levels.2: At the final ascent, walk left into the recess above the horizontal wall spring.
levels.3: Approach the wall spring slowly so it does not launch you past the opening. Step into the left alcove, jump above the spring, and enter the Giant Ring before allowing the spring to carry you upward.

levels.1: Water movement creates the only safe attack height.
levels.2: Run away from the rising whirlpool, then use its collapse or bomb bursts as platforms.
levels.3: Keep moving while the propeller pulls water upward. When it stops, jump from the shrinking water column, or time a jump just before a dropped bomb bursts, to reach the cockpit. Land eight total hits without standing over an exploding bomb.

levels.1: The moving black platforms pass a concealed side opening.
levels.2: In the snaking-platform chamber, ride the highest platform to the left wall above the water.
levels.3: Remain on the uppermost segment while the linked black platforms snake around the chamber. At its highest leftward pass, jump into the wall alcove just above the waterline to reach the Giant Ring.

levels.1: Inspect the twin-column shaft shortly before the final route.
levels.2: Ride the right blue column to its highest point and jump into the wall.
levels.3: Where two vertical columns move against opposite walls, board the right one. Wait for its absolute peak, then jump right at full height; the hidden alcove above the ordinary corridor contains the ring.

levels.1: A second movement set opens passages the faster route can miss.
levels.2: Revisit both acts as Tails alone, then with Sonic and a controller-two helper.
levels.3: Use Tails' flight, swimming, and carrying in every vertical split; then repeat as Sonic alone for grounded-only paths. A cleared save permits act selection, so no new story run is required.

areas.name: Marble Garden Zone
areas.location_cue: the grassy ruins with stone pillars and spinning tops
areas.note: Many Giant Rings sit on mutually branching routes; revisit through zone select.

levels.1: The drill tips are dangerous; its centre is not.
levels.2: Dodge the ceiling drop and falling spikes, then strike while the drills rotate upward.
levels.3: Attack the thin centre only when the drill points face away. During the ceiling phase, ignore harmless rubble, avoid pointed debris, and sidestep the downward plunge. Six centre hits clear the gate.

levels.1: The upper route hides an opening opposite its turn.
levels.2: On the alternate route's first spin-dash curve, stop before travelling left and face right.
levels.3: At the curve beside a Spiker and an invincibility monitor, charge toward the right-hand wall instead of continuing left. The wall is false and opens directly into the first ring room.

levels.1: A ceiling passage links two separated corridors.
levels.2: From the first ring, fly through the hidden ceiling, cross the ring corridor, then rise again.
levels.3: With Tails, ascend through the unmarked ceiling above Ring #1, travel past the loose rings and monitors, and fly through the second opening. Sonic can instead enter later from the hidden wall beside the speed monitor.

levels.1: A high ledge overlooks the crusher route.
levels.2: Beyond the drill machine and paired crushers, look to the upper-left ledge opposite a Flame Shield.
levels.3: Climb to the Flame Shield ledge, take a running jump onto the chained rotating platforms, then leap left at their high point. The Giant Ring sits on the isolated upper-left shelf.

levels.1: A spinning top can carry you beyond a tempting ledge.
levels.2: Below the Flame Shield ledge, ride the grounded top toward the room's upper-right corner.
levels.3: Mount the spinning top and steer it back around the Flame Shield area. Keep rising toward the upper-right opening; a narrow corridor containing a life monitor ends at the Giant Ring chamber.

levels.1: One spinning-top climb has a hidden destination on its starting side.
levels.2: After the loop and tall blue pillar, use the next top but remain against the upper-left wall.
levels.3: Ride the top up the left wall. Do not redirect toward the normal right-hand ledge; continue pressing into the upper-left corner until the false wall admits you to the ring room.

levels.1: The second top crosses above a hazardous floor worth inspecting.
levels.2: Instead of hovering right from the second spinning top, drop into the long sludge pit.
levels.3: Dismount at the bottom before the top carries you to the next ledge. Land safely in the sludge section and move all the way left; the corner wall hides the Giant Ring.

levels.1: The first checkpoint split rewards its lower branch.
levels.2: Take the descending path, then use the horizontal red spring at the later curve.
levels.3: From the checkpoint beside the steep fork, descend through the loop and blue pillar. Hit the red spring facing the curve; maintain speed through the launch and land on the upper-right shelf beyond the spikes.

levels.1: The upper fork crosses a spike pit with one extra landing.
levels.2: At the checkpoint split, climb the upper road and continue past the stone face.
levels.3: After the path bends left, cross the long spike pit using the moving platforms. Do not drop at the far end; use the trio of rotating platforms to enter the hidden left wall.

levels.1: The moving arena requires controlling both flight and attack height.
levels.2: Tap Up to lift the carrier, then jump from it only when the drill approach is clear.
levels.3: With Sonic, steer Tails using the directional pad and jump off to strike above or behind the drill. Tails alone must attack with his spinning tails from underneath. Track the four approach directions and total eight hits.

levels.1: The highest shortcut has a concealed exit from its long pillar.
levels.2: Take Tails' upper route; after the loop, leave the blue pillar to the left.
levels.3: Fly to the top route, pass through the loop, and begin descending the long blue pillar. Jump left before it ejects you right, then drop into the small opening and walk through the right wall.

levels.1: The main path hides a room below a rising platform.
levels.2: After the first indoor section, search beneath the lift beside a Spiker and crusher.
levels.3: Ignore the faster branch and drop under the rising platform. Pass the crusher, destroy the Spiker, and enter the room to its right. The enemy was covering the spring needed to leave.

levels.1: The lowest spinning-top shaft has a side exit at floor level.
levels.2: Stay on the full loop-and-pillar route until a grounded top enters a tall dark shaft.
levels.3: Dismount before the top climbs. At the bottom of the shaft, walk left into the low corridor rather than rising; its end wall conceals the final ring room.

levels.1: A second movement set opens passages the faster route can miss.
levels.2: Revisit both acts as Tails alone, then with Sonic and a controller-two helper.
levels.3: Use Tails' flight, swimming, and carrying in every vertical split; then repeat as Sonic alone for grounded-only paths. A cleared save permits act selection, so no new story run is required.

areas.name: Carnival Night Zone
areas.location_cue: the neon carnival interior with balloons and striped drums
areas.note: The standalone campaign cannot access Knuckles-only ring rooms.

levels.1: Protect the descending floor before it develops too many gaps.
levels.2: Open the upper machine so its own bouncing spinner can strike it.
levels.3: Stand left when the spinner drops right. Jump into the moving upper machine to open it, then let the spinner rebound into the exposed centre. Repeat four times while staying off the spinner's underside and preserving floor blocks.

levels.1: Check beneath an early striped pole instead of riding it onward.
levels.2: Use the earliest diagonal striped pole: fall underneath, then climb the curved wall on the left.
levels.3: Ride that pole downward only far enough to jump beneath it. Carry momentum around the lower bend and up the left side, where the hidden route feeds directly into the ring room.

levels.1: A hidden corridor joins the aerial shortcut to the normal route.
levels.2: With Tails, pass the spikes on the upper shortcut and enter the right wall.
levels.3: Fly through the early shortcut beyond the spike line and continue into the false right wall. Sonic alone can enter the opposite end just left of the descending platform and large wheel before the first checkpoint.

levels.1: A curved return to the main route is itself hollow.
levels.2: On Sonic's early high shortcut, spin-dash into the right wall immediately below the checkpoint.
levels.3: Use the large wheel to reach the upper-right ledge, then spin-dash up its curve. Hold right through the apparent wall instead of exiting upward; the ring chamber is embedded inside it.

levels.1: Stay high when the route reaches its first tall black cylinders.
levels.2: Before entering the yellow tubes, check the right wall beneath the wall spikes.
levels.3: After the first checkpoint, cross the narrow upright platforms leading to the tall cylinders. Enter the false right wall below the spikes; dropping into the yellow tube network closes this approach.

levels.1: The lowest three-cylinder room has a shield guarding a passage.
levels.2: Descend to the large room with three tall cylinders and inspect its right ledge.
levels.3: From Ring #4, continue downward whenever the path allows. In the three-cylinder chamber, reach the ledge on the right and pass through the wall directly behind the Water Shield monitor.

levels.1: The lower orb is a hazard until it reconnects.
levels.2: Keep away during the magnetic pull, then attack as the craft descends to retrieve its orb.
levels.3: Jump repeatedly while the electrical field drags you across the floor. Once it ends, cross over the detached orb and strike the descending cockpit above its arms. Repeat that recovery window for eight hits.

levels.1: The first pole shortcut has a lower companion corridor.
levels.2: Jump from the long striped pole to the ledge below the shortcut entrance.
levels.3: Leap from the striped pole into the lower corridor. Alternatively, reach the first cannon, enter the left wall, open the twenty-ring and Water Shield monitors, then drop through that room's floor.

levels.1: The required rotating drums lift you beside a false wall.
levels.2: In the tall drum room, reach the platform holding a Flame Shield and ten rings.
levels.3: Control the two vertical drums by alternately pressing down and up. When you reach the Flame Shield platform, walk into the left wall; the Giant Ring chamber is on the same level.

levels.1: A moving drum masks an opening during the next elevator climb.
levels.2: Above the previous ring, enter the left wall of the long elevator shaft.
levels.3: Ascend the shaft until the crushing drum passes the left-side opening. Move through only while the drum is rising away; being pinned between it and the floor is fatal.

levels.1: Late balloons lead higher than the ordinary exit.
levels.2: Before the final checkpoint, climb every balloon in the tall chamber and aim top right.
levels.3: Bounce upward without missing a balloon, because this room may not reset them conveniently. From the highest balloon, steer into the concealed corridor at the upper-right ceiling.

levels.1: A second movement set opens passages the faster route can miss.
levels.2: Revisit both acts as Tails alone, then with Sonic and a controller-two helper.
levels.3: Use Tails' flight, swimming, and carrying in every vertical split; then repeat as Sonic alone for grounded-only paths. A cleared save permits act selection, so no new story run is required.

areas.name: IceCap Zone
areas.location_cue: the snowy mountain and blue ice caverns
areas.note: The repeating slope in Act 1 grants unlimited attempts at its hidden opening.

levels.1: Wait out the protective orbit before attacking.
levels.2: Stay in a corner during the snowball sweep, then strike after the second pass.
levels.3: Do not challenge the eight orbiting snowballs. Let the machine cross twice, move under it when the balls launch upward, and land one or two hits before they fall. Six hits clear the gate; Lightning Shield extends reach.

levels.1: An early collapsible floor distracts from the wall beside it.
levels.2: After the checkpoint and four breakable blocks, ignore the button and enter the right wall.
levels.3: Approach the thin floor beneath the small pointer mechanism, but do not activate its collapse. Continue directly into the ice wall on the right to find the ring room.

levels.1: One wall in the repeating tumble is an opening, not an obstacle.
levels.2: During the endless slope loop, jump from a left-hand slope toward the right wall.
levels.3: Watch for the transfer where the right wall contains a small blue recess rather than the true exit platform. Jump as you enter that left slope and hold right; the loop repeats until you succeed.

levels.1: The safest attack window is opposite an active side nozzle.
levels.2: Use the hanging platform, then jump upward while a side freeze blast is firing.
levels.3: Board the platform and wait for either side nozzle to fire. Jump past the quiet centre nozzle and hit the cockpit, retreating before the centre activates. After six hits the platform falls away; attack the exposed front twice more.

levels.1: A sinking ice ledge reveals a doorway below the waterline.
levels.2: After the two penguins, remain on the small ice ledge until it submerges.
levels.3: Follow the mid-act route through three loops to the penguin platform. Step onto the sinking ledge beside it, wait until the right wall aligns, then jump through. A red spring directly below returns you afterward.

levels.1: The final catapult can reach a second landing above the route.
levels.2: After the late loops and short ramp, use the catapult toward the upper-right platform.
levels.3: Carry speed through the final loops into the catapult, then steer right at its release. Land above the normal path and walk into the nearby wall opening to reach the last Giant Ring.

levels.1: A second movement set opens passages the faster route can miss.
levels.2: Revisit both acts as Tails alone, then with Sonic and a controller-two helper.
levels.3: Use Tails' flight, swimming, and carrying in every vertical split; then repeat as Sonic alone for grounded-only paths. A cleared save permits act selection, so no new story run is required.

areas.name: Launch Base Zone
areas.location_cue: the yellow-and-purple machinery spread across a lake
areas.note: Enter the consecutive gate sequence with time and rings in reserve.

levels.1: Wait until the swinging weapons fold inward.
levels.2: Attack the centre only after both spike arms retract.
levels.3: Keep the mechanism following you until its two spikeballs return to the body. Jump into the upper centre without touching the lower tip. Three hits remove one arm; three more clear the gate.

levels.1: The first rotating cylinder has a useful space beneath it.
levels.2: Drop below the cylinder, move left, and stand on the rising guillotine.
levels.3: At the first large cylinder, descend rather than crossing over it. Walk left to the purple wall tunnel and ride the adjacent guillotine upward until you can jump into the ring corridor.

levels.1: Tails' first elevator route continues behind its apparent exit.
levels.2: As Tails, ride the first elevator upward, take the spinning cup, then fly left.
levels.3: Exit the elevator's upper room and use the corkscrew cup. At its peak, ignore the indicated rightward path; fly left across the collapsing ledge and enter the purple corridor. Other characters can backtrack here after routes rejoin.

levels.1: A red spring above a flamethrower begins the hidden route.
levels.2: After the long slopes, use that spring and ride the falling platforms left.
levels.3: Find a low wall-mounted flame jet whose top supports a red spring. Bounce up, cross both descending platforms toward the left, pass the remaining fire jets, and leap into the purple opening beyond them.

levels.1: Conserve time and rings for several consecutive mechanical gates.
levels.2: The act timer continues through all three arenas; enter the first with several minutes available.
levels.3: First, use the hinged hatch as a platform and hit the cockpit eight times while avoiding alternating black shots. Next, jump above paired lasers: four hits remove each column and a ninth ends it. Finally, stand opposite each charge, jump above the hands but below the roof spikes, and land eight precise cockpit hits. A grab-and-slam strips even the transformed state.

levels.1: The first open water hides a doorway behind your entry point.
levels.2: After the opening cup, drop between the two platforms, swim right, then turn left underwater.
levels.3: Leave the starting cup, fall through the platform gap, and enter the water on the right. Immediately reverse into the submerged left wall; the hidden room begins almost beneath the place where you landed.

levels.1: A lower route beneath a long cylinder ends at a wall opening.
levels.2: When the main path turns left along the rotating cylinder, drop below it and follow the lower branch.
levels.3: Stay on the lower route until a corkscrew cup lifts you. At the top, face the ring tunnel in the left wall; Sonic should spin-dash from the right ledge and add only a tiny jump to enter cleanly.

levels.1: The upper late branch contains two stacked cylinders with space between them.
levels.2: Take the high curve and two cups, then aim between the cylinders at the far-right wall.
levels.3: Maintain speed up the high branch, ride both corkscrew cups, and stop before the paired rotating cylinders. Cross through their middle gap and continue into the false wall on the far right.

levels.1: A long purple wall tunnel appears only briefly beside a speed strip.
levels.2: On the late main route, jump into the protruding purple tunnel before the floor zipper launches you away.
levels.3: Approach the visible purple passage from the main path, or shortly after Tails' shortcut rejoins it. Jump early and hold toward the wall; touching the speed strip first removes the opportunity on that pass.

levels.1: Two early alarm lights can sustain a score chain.
levels.2: Stand between the alarm posts near Act 1's start and hold a charged spin-dash.
levels.3: Trigger the flying enemies, position just right of centre between the alarms, and keep Down plus a jump button held without releasing the dash. Repeated collisions build the score chain into extra lives; stop before the act timer becomes unsafe.

levels.1: A second movement set opens passages the faster route can miss.
levels.2: Revisit both acts as Tails alone, then with Sonic and a controller-two helper.
levels.3: Use Tails' flight, swimming, and carrying in every vertical split; then repeat as Sonic alone for grounded-only paths. A cleared save permits act selection, so no new story run is required.

areas.name: Special Stages
areas.location_cue: the checkerboard sphere filled with coloured balls
areas.note: Every stage rotates back after later Giant Ring entries.

levels.1: Large hidden gateways need no carried-ring requirement.
levels.2: Enter any Giant Ring before finishing its act.
levels.3: Jump through a Giant Ring to start the next stage in the seven-stage rotation. The sequence advances even after a failed attempt and wraps after Stage 7, so another gateway eventually returns every uncleared layout.

levels.1: This trial is organised around paired square groups.
levels.2: Collect all 102 blue spheres without touching a red sphere.
levels.3: Turn at checkerboard intersections and circle complete blue rectangles whenever possible. For this layout, clear outside clusters before the centre. Touching red ends the attempt, but the rotating sequence gives another chance after later gateways.

levels.1: The emerald objective leaves one optional collection layer.
levels.2: Collect all 64 rings before taking the final blue sphere.
levels.3: Convert every eligible blue block by tracing its full perimeter, then sweep up all loose and converted rings. Preserve one clearly reachable blue sphere until the ring counter reaches 64; take it last to finish with the Perfect award.

levels.1: This trial is organised around large perimeter rectangles.
levels.2: Collect all 127 blue spheres without touching a red sphere.
levels.3: Turn at checkerboard intersections and circle complete blue rectangles whenever possible. For this layout, reserve one isolated blue sphere. Touching red ends the attempt, but the rotating sequence gives another chance after later gateways.

levels.1: The emerald objective leaves one optional collection layer.
levels.2: Collect all 111 rings before taking the final blue sphere.
levels.3: Convert every eligible blue block by tracing its full perimeter, then sweep up all loose and converted rings. Preserve one clearly reachable blue sphere until the ring counter reaches 111; take it last to finish with the Perfect award.

levels.1: This trial is organised around narrow lanes and bumpers.
levels.2: Collect all 118 blue spheres without touching a red sphere.
levels.3: Turn at checkerboard intersections and circle complete blue rectangles whenever possible. For this layout, use reversals only on safe lines. Touching red ends the attempt, but the rotating sequence gives another chance after later gateways.

levels.1: The emerald objective leaves one optional collection layer.
levels.2: Collect all 80 rings before taking the final blue sphere.
levels.3: Convert every eligible blue block by tracing its full perimeter, then sweep up all loose and converted rings. Preserve one clearly reachable blue sphere until the ring counter reaches 80; take it last to finish with the Perfect award.

levels.1: This trial is organised around symmetrical blue blocks.
levels.2: Collect all 115 blue spheres without touching a red sphere.
levels.3: Turn at checkerboard intersections and circle complete blue rectangles whenever possible. For this layout, work one mirrored side at once. Touching red ends the attempt, but the rotating sequence gives another chance after later gateways.

levels.1: The emerald objective leaves one optional collection layer.
levels.2: Collect all 80 rings before taking the final blue sphere.
levels.3: Convert every eligible blue block by tracing its full perimeter, then sweep up all loose and converted rings. Preserve one clearly reachable blue sphere until the ring counter reaches 80; take it last to finish with the Perfect award.

levels.1: This trial is organised around a short accelerating layout.
levels.2: Collect all 58 blue spheres without touching a red sphere.
levels.3: Turn at checkerboard intersections and circle complete blue rectangles whenever possible. For this layout, collect converted rings before finishing. Touching red ends the attempt, but the rotating sequence gives another chance after later gateways.

levels.1: The emerald objective leaves one optional collection layer.
levels.2: Collect all 54 rings before taking the final blue sphere.
levels.3: Convert every eligible blue block by tracing its full perimeter, then sweep up all loose and converted rings. Preserve one clearly reachable blue sphere until the ring counter reaches 54; take it last to finish with the Perfect award.

levels.1: This trial is organised around the densest blue layout.
levels.2: Collect all 128 blue spheres without touching a red sphere.
levels.3: Turn at checkerboard intersections and circle complete blue rectangles whenever possible. For this layout, leave one obvious group untouched. Touching red ends the attempt, but the rotating sequence gives another chance after later gateways.

levels.1: The emerald objective leaves one optional collection layer.
levels.2: Collect all 64 rings before taking the final blue sphere.
levels.3: Convert every eligible blue block by tracing its full perimeter, then sweep up all loose and converted rings. Preserve one clearly reachable blue sphere until the ring counter reaches 64; take it last to finish with the Perfect award.

levels.1: This trial is organised around compact turning lanes.
levels.2: Collect all 60 blue spheres without touching a red sphere.
levels.3: Turn at checkerboard intersections and circle complete blue rectangles whenever possible. For this layout, commit to early turns as speed rises. Touching red ends the attempt, but the rotating sequence gives another chance after later gateways.

levels.1: The emerald objective leaves one optional collection layer.
levels.2: Collect all 74 rings before taking the final blue sphere.
levels.3: Convert every eligible blue block by tracing its full perimeter, then sweep up all loose and converted rings. Preserve one clearly reachable blue sphere until the ring counter reaches 74; take it last to finish with the Perfect award.

levels.1: Every successful sphere trial contributes to one saved set.
levels.2: Clear all seven rotating Special Stages on the same character file.
levels.3: Use early Giant Rings aggressively; failures only move the rotation forward. Continue entering later rings until every layout has been cleared. The file retains each emerald after the automatic save that follows a Special Stage.

levels.1: The complete set changes Sonic's second aerial input.
levels.2: On a Sonic file with all seven emeralds, collect fifty rings and jump twice.
levels.3: Reach 50 rings as Sonic after completing the emerald set, jump, then press a jump button again while airborne. The transformation consumes one ring per second and resists ordinary damage, but crushing, falling, drowning, and the final grab remain dangerous.

levels.1: Unused gateways change after the set is complete.
levels.2: Enter another Giant Ring after collecting every emerald.
levels.3: Once the saved file shows the full emerald set, any remaining Giant Ring no longer opens a trial. Enter it to receive fifty rings immediately; use this to trigger Sonic's transformation or restore a damaged route.

levels.1: A sound sequence opens an additional sphere layout outside normal progression.
levels.2: On Level Select, play 01, 03, 05, 07, then highlight Special Stage 2.
levels.3: Unlock Level Select, enter its sound test, and play 01, 03, 05, then 07. Highlight Special Stage 2, hold A, and press Start. Treat this as a separate secret demonstration; it is not part of the seven-emerald set.

areas.name: Gumball Bonus Stage
areas.location_cue: the vertical pinball chamber above a fifty-ring checkpoint
areas.note: The last collected shield remains after a controlled exit.

levels.1: A saved ring threshold makes checkpoint stars appear.
levels.2: Touch a checkpoint while holding at least fifty rings, then jump into its orbiting stars.
levels.3: Approach an unused checkpoint with 50 or more rings. After it spins, jump into the white star circle above it. This opens the gumball chamber without consuming your carried-ring requirement from the main act.

levels.1: One coloured capsule grants fire protection.
levels.2: Strike the red shield gumball before leaving the chamber.
levels.3: Bounce into the red Flame Shield gumball and verify the shield surrounds the character. Continue collecting if safe, but remember that falling out ends the chamber with the most recently obtained protection still equipped.

levels.1: One coloured capsule removes the air timer.
levels.2: Strike the blue shield gumball before leaving the chamber.
levels.3: Bounce into the blue Water Shield gumball and verify the spherical shield appears. Exit with it equipped when the next act section is submerged; replacing it with another shield removes its breathing protection.

levels.1: One coloured capsule attracts nearby rings.
levels.2: Strike the yellow shield gumball before leaving the chamber.
levels.3: Bounce into the yellow Lightning Shield gumball and confirm nearby rings move toward you. Exit while it remains the latest shield reward, because collecting either other elemental shield replaces it.

levels.1: A rare capsule increases the life counter directly.
levels.2: Remain in the chamber until the extra-life capsule descends within reach.
levels.3: Keep using the disappearing flippers to climb around the machine and intercept the life gumball. Confirm the life counter rises, then choose a controlled fall before the last bottom spring vanishes unexpectedly.

levels.1: Several capsules add different ring amounts.
levels.2: Collect the numbered ring gumballs and watch the carried total change.
levels.3: Hit each available ring capsule during repeated visits, including the higher-value variants. Clear gumballs do nothing; the dark penalty gumball removes rings, so do not mistake either for a reward.

levels.1: The chamber floor becomes less forgiving after every rebound.
levels.2: Track which flippers and bottom springs have already vanished.
levels.3: Each used flipper disappears, as does a bottom spring after one bounce. Before the lower safety row is exhausted, collect the preferred final reward and fall through deliberately; the character returns to the checkpoint with that reward.

areas.name: Completion Branches
areas.location_cue: the consecutive mechanical arenas reached from the lakeside machinery
areas.note: Preserve each character file before changing its emerald-set state.

save_backup.title: Back up all three save files
save_backup.why: The saved emerald state changes a permanent completion branch on each character file.

point_of_no_return.title: Completion-state branch lock
point_of_no_return.why: Crossing the consecutive mechanical arenas commits the current emerald-state presentation until the file is restored or replayed.

levels.1: One completion presentation appears before the saved emerald set is full.
levels.2: Finish the cartridge as Sonic & Tails while that file has fewer than seven emeralds.
levels.3: Use the backed-up Sonic & Tails file before its seventh emerald is recorded, clear the consecutive closing arenas, and let the entire credits sequence finish. Preserve this branch separately before restoring the backup for full-set completion.

levels.1: The full saved set changes the completion presentation.
levels.2: Collect all seven emeralds as Sonic & Tails, then finish the cartridge again.
levels.3: Restore the pre-branch backup, complete every remaining sphere trial on the Sonic & Tails file, and confirm all seven emeralds are displayed. Clear the closing arenas once more and watch through the credits. Sonic may use the transformed state after reaching fifty rings.

levels.1: One completion presentation appears before the saved emerald set is full.
levels.2: Finish the cartridge as Sonic Alone while that file has fewer than seven emeralds.
levels.3: Use the backed-up Sonic Alone file before its seventh emerald is recorded, clear the consecutive closing arenas, and let the entire credits sequence finish. Preserve this branch separately before restoring the backup for full-set completion.

levels.1: The full saved set changes the completion presentation.
levels.2: Collect all seven emeralds as Sonic Alone, then finish the cartridge again.
levels.3: Restore the pre-branch backup, complete every remaining sphere trial on the Sonic Alone file, and confirm all seven emeralds are displayed. Clear the closing arenas once more and watch through the credits. This file may use the transformed state after reaching fifty rings.

levels.1: One completion presentation appears before the saved emerald set is full.
levels.2: Finish the cartridge as Tails Alone while that file has fewer than seven emeralds.
levels.3: Use the backed-up Tails Alone file before its seventh emerald is recorded, clear the consecutive closing arenas, and let the entire credits sequence finish. Preserve this branch separately before restoring the backup for full-set completion.

levels.1: The full saved set changes the completion presentation.
levels.2: Collect all seven emeralds as Tails Alone, then finish the cartridge again.
levels.3: Restore the pre-branch backup, complete every remaining sphere trial on the Tails Alone file, and confirm all seven emeralds are displayed. Clear the closing arenas once more and watch through the credits. The completion presentation changes even though Tails cannot transform here.

areas.name: Competition
areas.location_cue: the split-screen menu with five looping race courses
areas.note: Complete every mode with both power-up settings.

levels.1: The longest competition choice links every available track.
levels.2: Select Competition, choose Grand Prix, then complete five laps on each track.
levels.3: Run the full five-track sequence twice: once with power-ups enabled and once disabled. A track is won by reaching five laps first; crossing the start pole before GO only restarts the countdown.

levels.1: A second mode isolates one track for two-player comparison.
levels.2: Choose Match Race and complete a five-lap contest on every selectable track.
levels.3: With two controllers connected, select each track individually and finish five laps. Repeat the set with power-ups toggled the opposite way so both rule configurations are represented.

levels.1: Solo competition stores more than one time per track.
levels.2: Choose Time Attack and fill all three record positions on every track.
levels.3: Complete every track three times so its record screen contains three saved results. Run Sonic, Tails, and Knuckles once each; the mode uses five laps and stores the finished times automatically.

levels.1: This five-lap course is the open lakeside course.
levels.2: Finish five laps here in Grand Prix, Match Race, and Time Attack.
levels.3: Use the lap pole as the route anchor and maintain momentum over water-side slopes and avoid over-jumping the short gaps. Record at least one clean finish with each selectable character while completing the three competition modes.

levels.1: This five-lap course is the bright course with balloons.
levels.2: Finish five laps here in Grand Prix, Match Race, and Time Attack.
levels.3: Use the lap pole as the route anchor and use balloons only where they preserve forward speed; recover low rather than bouncing backward. Record at least one clean finish with each selectable character while completing the three competition modes.

levels.1: This five-lap course is the metallic course with mechanisms.
levels.2: Finish five laps here in Grand Prix, Match Race, and Time Attack.
levels.3: Use the lap pole as the route anchor and time moving devices instead of forcing them, then carry speed through the aligned opening. Record at least one clean finish with each selectable character while completing the three competition modes.

levels.1: This five-lap course is the sandstone course with loops.
levels.2: Finish five laps here in Grand Prix, Match Race, and Time Attack.
levels.3: Use the lap pole as the route anchor and build speed before the tall curves and avoid reversing across the lap marker. Record at least one clean finish with each selectable character while completing the three competition modes.

levels.1: This five-lap course is the underground rail course.
levels.2: Finish five laps here in Grand Prix, Match Race, and Time Attack.
levels.3: Use the lap pole as the route anchor and stay centred through the cramped hazards and take the cleanest landing after each drop. Record at least one clean finish with each selectable character while completing the three competition modes.

levels.1: Each selectable racer deserves a complete stored track set.
levels.2: Use Sonic on all five tracks and record a Time Attack result.
levels.3: Complete one Grand Prix, one Match Race, and every Time Attack track with this selection. Its cartridge behaviour is standard jump without his single-player aerial shield technique; do not assume abilities from the later lock-on game.

levels.1: Each selectable racer deserves a complete stored track set.
levels.2: Use Tails on all five tracks and record a Time Attack result.
levels.3: Complete one Grand Prix, one Match Race, and every Time Attack track with this selection. Its cartridge behaviour is double-jump flight for vertical recovery; do not assume abilities from the later lock-on game.

levels.1: Each selectable racer deserves a complete stored track set.
levels.2: Use Knuckles on all five tracks and record a Time Attack result.
levels.3: Complete one Grand Prix, one Match Race, and every Time Attack track with this selection. Its cartridge behaviour is Sonic-like movement without later climbing or gliding abilities; do not assume abilities from the later lock-on game.

areas.name: Cartridge Secrets
areas.location_cue: the title screen, hidden sound test, and cleared-file act selector
areas.note: Use No Save or a copied SRAM file for code and glitch demonstrations.

levels.1: A short input fits inside the opening logo fade.
levels.2: During the SEGA fade, enter Up ×2, Down ×2, then Up ×4.
levels.3: Complete that eight-input pattern before the logo vanishes. At the title, move downward until Sound Test appears after Competition, then open it for stage selection and audio playback. Never use the unsafe powered cartridge-swap method.

levels.1: Level-select launches change one paused button.
levels.2: Start any act from Level Select, pause, then hold B.
levels.3: Enter an act through the hidden stage menu and pause during controllable play. Hold B to advance the action slowly; release it to stop, then unpause normally before returning to the clean save route.

levels.1: Another paused input moves the game by the smallest visible step.
levels.2: Start through Level Select, pause, and tap C.
levels.3: While an act launched from Level Select is paused, press C once for each single-frame advance. Demonstrate several isolated steps, then reset the disposable session so timing manipulation never contaminates completion evidence.

levels.1: An exact finishing timestamp yields the cartridge's largest time award.
levels.2: Cross an act goal when the timer reads precisely 9:59.
levels.3: Use a cleared-file act select, wait near the goal with a safe ring, and trigger completion during 9:59 before the ten-minute timeout. The tally awards 100,000 points; attempt this on a disposable run because one second late costs a life.

levels.1: One icy wall reacts to camera movement and a simultaneous input.
levels.2: In IceCap Act 1, pan the camera fully downward beside the otherwise blocked wall.
levels.3: Hold Down until the camera stops, release it, then press Up and jump together. When the screen begins rotating incorrectly, continue walking toward the wall to pass through. Reload afterward; this is a documented glitch, not the normal route.

levels.1: Several recordings distinguish this cartridge from later releases.
levels.2: Listen through the full credits and both acts of the three music-sensitive zones.
levels.3: On the standalone cartridge, record clean samples from Carnival Night, IceCap, Launch Base, the sub-gate cue, the third consecutive gate cue, the Knuckles cue, and the credits. Do not substitute modern replacement tracks.
